title: Playboy July 2005 Joanna Krupa Scarlett Johansson Complete w/ Centerfold

description:
Playboy magazine, July 2005. Original $4.99 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold. Cover: swimsuit model Joanna Krupa.

Cover features: The L Word's Karina Lombard; Scarlett Johansson 20Q; Owen Wilson interview; the Brando estate war; Canadian pot - undercover with the smugglers of BC Bud; the next seven natural disasters; white-hot white suits; new technology.

Back cover: Absolut Citron vodka ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
